notes:
Overview: Large BPO provider focused on retail and telecom clients. Heavy seasonal spikes (holiday cycles) + frequent incident bursts when upstream CRM is degraded. Primary ask: agent assist + reliable ticket summarization during extreme queue backpressure.

Key quotes: "We need answers when queues double overnight — no dropped context, graceful degradation to summaries and async responses." — Head of Ops.

Technical constraints: prefers VPC/private control plane for sensitive PII; Genesys routing in front, can forward requests via webhook -> Redwood. Strong requirement for audit logs and KMS integration; 7-year retention for certain client records (negotiable).

Performance targets: 95th pctile end-to-end agent assist turn < 350ms during normal ops; acceptable latency up to 1s during spikes if fallback summaries remain accurate. Throughput target: sustained 12k concurrent chats during peak season for the largest client (approx 50k tokens/min). Cost sensitivity moderate — will accept dedicated commit if unit cost predictable.

Reliability & failover needs: automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant on capacity pressure, multi-region routing for DR, deterministic KV prefix caching so same agent context persists across host failures. Wants explicit queue-backpressure indicators surfaced in Console and ability to throttle non-critical async tasks (summaries) to preserve real-time agent latency.

POC scope discussed: 1) integrate with Genesys to route sample traffic 2) run 72-hour spike test: synthetic holiday traffic + injected incidents (CRM timeouts) 3) validate model fallbacks and preserved context across redeploys 4) measure cost delta with batching + prefix caching.

Security review status: VRA submitted 2026-02-02, InfoSec follow-up scheduled; asked for SOC2 + encryption key flow diagram. Provided initial security FAQ (drive link).

Other notes / chatter: shorthand notes from calls — "SE: validate KV eviction policy vs long conversations", "AE: negotiate 6mo ramp with reserved commit", "CSM: prepare onboarding checklist for multiple client tenants".

Sales posture: strong conversion likelihood if POC shows <10% degraded quality when falling back and if Redwood can demonstrate predictable unit economics under spikes.
